rows.law: The handoff ledger is one append-only STATE register: procedure frozen once, live truth in a designated dated zone
rows.claim: next-window-handoff.md freezes the new-window procedure and routes all live truth into a single dated STATE section; superseded handoff files absorb into STATE entries instead of spawning new specs (graves c3 rows 1 to 5 are all ABSORBED-BY this register)
rows.steal: Before creating any new handoff document, append a dated bullet to the STATE section of next-window-handoff.md and register the event in watch/inbox/index_events.jsonl; retire superseded handoff files by grave receipt, never by a new spec file
rows.falsifier: A new window files a fresh standalone handoff spec, or git history shows the Procedure section edited while STATE is stale

rows.law: A real handoff is a metered correlation test: claimed, delivered, receiver_can_act_on; empty means gamma 1.00
rows.claim: mag/peer_handoff.py's entanglement check (meters law 2026-09-22) demands three meters per handoff; grave c2 found all 12 root peer-*.json status filed, none closed, ages 24 to 51 days, i.e. unmetered dead letters sitting in the open queue
rows.quote: empty = unmetered handoff (Γ = 1.00 by default until measured).
rows.steal: File every future peer handoff with claimed, delivered, and receiver_can_act_on filled via python main.py peer-handoff, and close or grave-receipt it after pickup so queue/handoff/peer-*.json holds only live work; trail lands in memory/handoff/peer_trail.jsonl
rows.falsifier: A peer-*.json ingested as actionable work while claimed/delivered/receiver_can_act_on are all empty, or one still status filed after weeks with no grave receipt

rows.law: Handoffs carry pack plus goal, never chat history
rows.claim: the standing load law keeps remote escalation as bounded pointers (context-pack + goal); residual on disk is truth and chat is heat, which is why graves cite briefs and check files rather than transcripts
rows.quote: Pack+goal to remotes, never chat history.
rows.steal: Route the next L2 escalation through mag.cmd context-pack plus a goal string into the target seat directory under queue/handoff/, instead of pasting transcript text; pointer lands in queue/handoff/<seat>/
rows.falsifier: Any handoff or escalation payload containing raw multi-turn chat transcript bytes

rows.law: Each handoff surface is a frozen v1 schema family with its own constant, checked by exact equality at ingest
rows.claim: six families verified on disk (handoff.v1, peer_handoff.v1, cloud_handoff.v1, auto_handoff.v1, gap_routed_handoff.v1, mag_voice_handoff.v1); handoff_inbox.py line 27 gates on payload schema exactly equal to handoff.v1; the tree holds 551 files across root queue plus 17 seat subdirs
rows.steal: A new handoff surface gets a new SCHEMA constant plus its own seat subdirectory under queue/handoff/, never a mutation of an existing family's payload; land it as mag/<surface>_handoff.py with the same equality gate
rows.falsifier: A handoff file whose schema value differs from its family constant is accepted by the matching ingest path

rows.law: The ledger must have a retirement path or it becomes a swamp; grave receipts are that path
rows.claim: the STATE register's own size law is brevity; tonight graves c1 (HANDOFF_MAG_AGENT_TODOS.md fossil, 7 weeks stale), c2 (12 dead peer jsons), c3 (goodnight/overnight group, 6 rows) receipt-buried 18+ entries as classify-not-delete with deletions operator-gated and successors verified on disk; zero bytes deleted, ledger shrinks by verdict not rm
rows.quote: Keep it short. Update the STATE section, not the procedure.
rows.steal: Close every retired handoff surface with a GALA_GRAVE_*.md receipt naming classification, absorbing successor, and successor-verified-on-disk, then register the burial in watch/inbox/index_events.jsonl; receipts land in watch/inbox/
rows.falsifier: queue/handoff/ file count grows session over session with no new grave receipts, or any grave deletes files instead of receipting them
